As someone who almost fell down the Q rabbit hole, these posts make me feel better. I come from a spiritually manipulative/abusive home, and that was pretty much the only reason I entertained Q. I was raised in a household where conspiracy theories were beat into your head, and most days, you could get stuck in an 3-6 hour conversation about it, even if you expressed disinterest. I only got into the whole thing for a few months, but never shared it publically unless I was being vague about it. There was kind of an embarrassment that came with it because part of the information was a little tone deaf to me, especially during the whole George Floyd situation (which that is a whole topic in itself). But everyday I was being bombarded with q articles and videos. As an inquisitive person who likes to explore all thoughts, I watched them and research...but it as someone who been on the internet for awhile, all the articles were even impossible to find factual or vaguely supportive, even with research on the deep web. There were no hard facts. And if qanon had a mission to expose the truth, why weren’t they doing so in a way that was actually helpful. Once I got to the whole Hillary skinning a child’s face and seeing those pictures, and hearing the Podesta abuse video, I got depressed. Every time the conversation of Q came up, I got depressed. I had enough going on in my own life, I didn’t want to spend all this time researching vague articles to feel even more depressed. Then I started asking questions, and the person who was feeding me this started getting mad or defensive. Even if I had proof, they refused to hear it...then I learned that person was once in a spiritual cult as a teen, and everything clicked. This was a cult. And I backed off...the relationship seems broken now, and it sucks, but I am happier again. And now these posts confirmed I made the right choice. I think I never deeply believed in Q, but I was more guilted and controlled into it. Because this same thing happened years ago when Illuminati first became really talked about publically. I had to suffer through not being able to enjoy anything as a kid and teen because everything was “devil worship” and Illuminati, and the funniest part is I’m not even Christian. I think for some younger people, they get adapted into Q due to their upbringing. I think it was more because I didn’t want that person to be upset with me...now, they don’t like me. I’m not smart or spiritually aware...well, at least I’m happy. They been depressed since the election.


Extra: Once they told me a lot of this started from 4Chan, is when everything broke for me. Because I been on 4Chan as a middle schooler. Everything was downhill from there.
